summary: Internship at the Ministry of Digital Development, Posts and Telecommunications (MNDPT), auditing EDUTIC, the system the government uses to digitize higher education.
highlights: Audited the EDUTIC system and reported on its weak points
Cleaned the EDUTIC database: duplicates, missing values and inconsistent records
Developed a matching algorithm to link related records in the database
Worked in Python with Pandas and scikit-learn

projects.name: EDUTIC audit
projects.description: Review of the government platform for higher education, with findings and recommendations.
